audit.whatIsWrong: Two missingInteractions were never stated: Morgana sustaining chip damage through Soul Siphon (P) and Tormented Shadow (W) unless Milio times Grievous Wounds, and Black Shield (E) creating terrain that can cut off Milio's dashless retreat.
audit.why: Both are confirmed applicable for this matchup and change concrete decisions (itemization timing, Flash usage).
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[1].d (anti-heal timing) and dontsFull[2].d (hold Flash for the E wall).

edits.before: - Morgana Dark Binding: matchup-defining — The three-second root — minion-block it; the pool follows wherever it lands. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep R Breath of Life banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Morgana Dark Binding (Q): flat 10s cooldown, a 3-second root — minion-block it; the duo's whole tempo bends around it. - Her R Soul Shackles is 120/110/100s; keep your R Breath of Life banked to answer it, not to season trades.
